comparison.objective: Perform one safe passive elbow range-of-motion repetition versus tune a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Gentle articulated-limb support and controlled flexion/extension versus tool insertion, rotary adjustment, locking, and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: One 80–100 degree repetition returned safely to rest versus two non-bottoming carriage cycles with retained setting.
comparison.reason: Shared force limitation is generic; the controlled objects, sequence, and measured outcome differ. Candidate leaves several safety and retention thresholds undeclared.
